purpose: Authenticated Boardmix export and reload trial using an independently created simulated board
privacy_boundary: The private Boardmix URL and account details are intentionally omitted from the public repository

board.title: Diagram Studio Export Trial
content:
用户入口｜报名后开始学习
长文本测试：导出时需要保留对象、层级、连线和来源。

报名结果
确认页展示时间、下一步入口和异常恢复。

第一课
从确认页进入课程；按钮名称保持可读。

actions: Created a new blank personal Boardmix board for this trial
Renamed it to Diagram Studio Export Trial
Created three long-text sticky notes and two arrow connectors
Opened the image export dialog, selected SVG, all-area export, no watermark, and observed 导出成功
Opened the PDF export dialog, selected 16:9, no margin, all-area export, no watermark, and observed 导出成功
Opened the Markdown export dialog; all three notes were listed and Export (3) observed, then observed 导出成功
Opened the JSON export dialog; it reported no exportable mind-map content and kept export disabled
Reloaded the editor and observed all three notes and both arrows; the details panel reported 5 elements and 72 board words
